target: Finite actual-subgroup inclusion diagrams for Out(F_n), n >= 2, and extended closed-unmarked-surface mapping class groups Mod±(S_g), g >= 1.
hypotheses: Closed, unmarked, connected orientable surface of genus g >= 1; both orientation signs allowed.
Finite diagram of actual finite subgroups; arrows are inclusions; canonical group-colimit map must be an isomorphism.
Equivalent geometric target uses a developable simple finite-group complex on a simply connected base.
accepted_conclusions: Credited classical GL(2,Z)=D8*_(D4)D12 endpoint, with actual matrix subgroups and R^2=1 restored in the complete presentation.
All-rank signed-permutation/theta actual intersections in Aut and Out, surjection of the amalgam, and an explicit infinite-order eight-syllable kernel element.
Subordinate-diagram retraction preserves the obstruction; equality of colimits requires additional arrows into containing factors.
H^2(G;Q)=0 for any colimit of finite groups; restriction in H^2 with torsion-free trivial coefficients is injective.
Explicit Z^2 excludes graph-of-finite-groups descriptions for n >= 3 and g >= 2.
C2*C3 distinguishes a successful finite subsystem from the inclusion colimit of all finite subgroups.
remaining_gap: Prove injectivity for a finite higher-dimensional actual-subgroup inclusion diagram in the higher cases, or find an obstruction applying to every such finite diagram.
